title: 第一卷 第46章 下朝后去坤宁宫挑一个
slug: 大明死谏一百次老朱破防了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

信里说程壑川与徐妙云见面三次。

第一次在魏国公府后院，他与徐达讨论《元史》书稿，徐妙云在场，三人共饮。

第二次在城门口，程壑川赴河南赈灾，徐达与徐妙云相送，徐妙云赠送坐垫一只。

第三次在茶楼，程壑川目送迎亲队伍出城，徐妙云掀帘相望，四目相对。

朱棣看完信，沉默了很久，把信放在烛火上烧了。

灰烬落在铜盘里，他伸出手指在灰烬上轻轻拨了拨。

"来人。"朱棣叫了一声。

一个侍从推门进来："殿下。"

"备轿，我要进宫。"朱棣站起身。

夜色中的皇宫格外安静。

朱棣穿过一道道宫门，来到乾清宫的时候，朱元璋正在批阅奏折，马皇后坐在旁边绣花。

"儿臣朱棣，参见父皇，参见母后。"

朱元璋抬起头看了他一眼："这么晚了，什么事？"

朱棣跪在地上，斟酌着措辞："父皇，儿臣今日去了魏国公府，见到了程壑川程御史。"

朱元璋放下朱笔："你见他做什么？"

"程御史在给国公爷看病。儿臣跟他聊了几句，觉得此人确实如传闻中一样，才华出众，胆识过人。二十五岁的年纪，就已经是四品佥都御史，在朝中做了不少实事，替王弼翻过案，在河南赈过灾，现在又在替国公爷诊治。这样的人，将来必成大器。"

朱元璋听着，没有打断。

马皇后也放下绣花针，看着朱棣。

朱棣顿了顿，继续说："但儿臣听说，程大人今年二十五了，还没有成家。这么优秀的人才，却孤身一人，实在是朝廷的损失。儿臣斗胆想，父皇和母后身边有没有合适的人选，给他物色一门婚事？"

朱元璋靠在椅背上，手指一下一下敲着扶手："程壑川成不成家，关你什么事？"

朱棣面不改色："回父皇，儿臣是觉得，像程大人这样的人才，应该有人照顾。他在朝中得罪了不少人，若是有个家室，也能让他更安稳。再者说，他无父无母，婚事无人替他张罗，父皇若能赐婚，是恩典，也是笼络。"

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The letter said that Cheng Hechuan and Xu Miaoyun met three times.

For the first time, he and Xu Da discussed the manuscript of "History of the Yuan Dynasty" in the backyard of Wei Guogong's mansion. Xu Miaoyun was present and the three of them drank together.

The second time at the gate of the city, Cheng Hechuan went to Henan to provide disaster relief. Xu Da and Xu Miaoyun saw each other off, and Xu Miaoyun presented him with a cushion.

The third time at the teahouse, Cheng Hechuan watched the wedding party leave the city. Xu Miaoyun raised the curtain and looked at each other, their eyes facing each other.

After Zhu Di read the letter, he was silent for a long time, then put the letter on the candle and burned it.

The ashes fell into the copper plate, and he stretched out his fingers to gently stir around the ashes.

"Come here." Zhu Di called.

An attendant pushed the door open and came in: "Your Highness."

"Prepare the sedan, I want to enter the palace." Zhu Di stood up.

The palace was particularly quiet at night.

When Zhu Di passed through the palace gates and arrived at the Qianqing Palace, Zhu Yuanzhang was reviewing memorials, and Queen Ma was sitting next to him embroidering.

"My son Zhu Di, see my father and the emperor, and see my mother and queen."

Zhu Yuanzhang raised his head and glanced at him: "It's so late, what's the matter?"

Zhu Di knelt on the ground, thinking carefully about his words: "Father, I went to the Duke of Wei's Mansion today and met Cheng Yushi Cheng Hechuan."

Zhu Yuanzhang put down his ink pen: "What did you do when you saw him?"

"Cheng Yushi was treating the Duke of Guo. After chatting with him for a few words, I felt that this person was indeed as talented and courageous as the rumors said. At the age of twenty-five, he was already the censor of the Fourth Grade Qiandu. He had done a lot of practical things in the court, including resolving Wang Bi's case, relieving disasters in Henan, and now he is treating the Duke of Guo. Such a person will definitely become a great asset in the future."

Zhu Yuanzhang listened without interrupting.

Queen Ma also put down her embroidery needle and looked at Zhu Di.

Zhu Di paused and continued: "But I heard that Mr. Cheng is twenty-five this year and has not married yet. It is really a loss for the court that such an outstanding talent is alone. I dare to think about whether there are suitable candidates around my father and mother to find a marriage for him?"

Zhu Yuanzhang leaned back on the chair and tapped the armrest with his fingers: "Whether Cheng Hechuan has a family or not, what does it have to do with you?"

Zhu Di said without changing his expression: "Back to my father, I feel that someone like Mr. Cheng should be taken care of. He has offended many people in the court, and it would make him more stable if he had a family. Furthermore, he has no father or mother, and no one will arrange the marriage for him. If my father can grant a marriage, it is a grace and a win-win."
